1.20.1.2.1.1: Darkness fix: you can now see 12 blocks in the dark (was 5) and it is a little less black. Update notifier added.
1.20.1.2.1.2: Brighter nights: you now see 48 blocks in the dark (radius 48, intensity 0.3). Change it in config/pitchdark-common.toml.
1.20.1.2.2.0: Smarter mimics: SimpleMimics replaced by Dead Silence Mimics (unofficial fork, credit AkaneDev). Hunting mimic that disguises, approaches, transforms and attacks; voice recording now needs each player's opt-in (/mimicvoice on). Host-only AI button in the pause menu.
1.20.1.2.3.0: Realistic look: added Oculus (shader loader) and the Complementary Reimagined shader pack, on by default. Change or turn off in Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs.
1.20.1.2.4.0: A box now pops up in the bottom right (title screen, pause menu, and when you join a world) whenever a newer pack version is out. Click it to open the download page.
1.20.1.2.4.1: TEST ONLY: fake update to check the bottom-right notice. Ignore.
